0022600149.text: The Atlanta Hawks (3-3, 2nd in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, 7th in the East) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (1-4, 5th in the Southwest and 4 games back, 14th in the West) in Atlanta's 7th game of the season. Atlanta is 2-1 on the road and currently on a one-game win streak, while New Orleans is 1-2 at home and also on a one-game win streak after going 1-4 in its last five. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks swept the Pelicans 2-0 in 2025-26 and beat them 117-100 in Atlanta on January 7, 2026. Missing for Atlanta are Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and missing for New Orleans are Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), all listed as out.
